subject: Engineering Chemistry
chapters: Metal Complexes, Rare Earth Elements and Metal alloys

questions.text: What is buffer capacity? Calculate the pH change in buffer solution made by mixing 150 ml of 0.5 M acetic acid and 450 ml of 0.1 M sodium acetate in which 10 ml of 0.2 M HCl is added. ($K_a = 1.8 \times 10^{-5}$).

questions.chapter: Metal Complexes, Rare Earth Elements and Metal alloys
questions.text: On the basis of Werner's theory, explain why $[\text{Co}(\text{NH}_3)_3\text{Cl}_3]$ does not give white precipitate with $\text{AgNO}_3$ but $[\text{Co}(\text{NH}_3)_6\text{Cl}_3]$ gives precipitate with $\text{AgNO}_3$ solution.
What do you mean by inorganic polymers? Mention the applications of silicones in engineering field. Show your acquaintance with polymeric sulphur nitride.

questions.chapter: Metal Complexes, Rare Earth Elements and Metal alloys
questions.text: Explain the formation of $[\text{NiCl}_4]^{2-}$ and $[\text{Ni}(\text{CN})_4]^{2-}$ complex on the basis of VBT and predict their geometry and magnetic behaviour.

What is meant by standard electrode potential? How does a galvanic cell differ from an electrolytic cell? Calculate the EMF of the cell at $25^\circ\text{C}$: $\text{Zn} \mid \text{Zn}^{2+}(0.1\text{ M}) \parallel \text{Fe}^{2+}(0.01\text{ M}) \mid \text{Fe}$ given $E^\circ_{\text{Zn}^{2+}/\text{Zn}} = -0.76\text{ V}$, $E^\circ_{\text{Fe}^{2+}/\text{Fe}} = -0.44\text{ V}$.

Define an electrochemical cell. What is the role of salt bridge in a voltaic cell? Calculate the EMF of the following cell: $\text{Mn} \mid \text{Mn}^{2+}(0.1\text{ M}) \parallel \text{Fe}^{2+}(1.0\text{ M}) \mid \text{Fe}$ when $E^\circ_{\text{Fe}^{2+}/\text{Fe}} = -0.44\text{ V}$ and $E^\circ_{\text{Mn}^{2+}/\text{Mn}} = -1.18\text{ V}$.
What are homogeneous and heterogeneous catalysts? Describe the intermediate compound formation theory of catalysis with suitable examples.
Differentiate between negative catalysis and catalytic poisoning. How does a catalyst work and what is the role of a promoter?
How is ozone formed and depleted in nature? What are the consequences of depletion of ozone layer in the atmosphere?
What is water pollution? Write down its major sources, effects on mankind, and possible control measures.
What is conducting polymer? Give the preparation and uses of Teflon and Nylon 6,6.

questions.chapter: Metal Complexes, Rare Earth Elements and Metal alloys
questions.text: What are d-block elements? Why is Zn not considered to be a true transition element? Explain why transition elements exhibit variable oxidation states and form colorful compounds.
What are low and high explosives? Write the preparation and uses of TNT and TNG.
Define lubricants and mention their functions. What are the requisites of a good paint?
Describe the unimolecular nucleophilic substitution ($S_N1$) reaction in haloalkanes with suitable examples. What are the factors governing the mechanism of $S_N1$ and $S_N2$ reactions?
Describe the mechanism of $E2$ elimination reaction with a suitable example. Give the differences between $E1$ and $E2$ reaction mechanisms.
